SESSION_TURN_SETTLED.definition: session.status is not one of UNSETTLED_SESSION_STATUSES (PENDING, RUNNING).
isNot: SESSION_RUN_TERMINAL: AWAITING_INPUT and INTERRUPTED are settled but not terminal.
TASK_DONE: a settled turn says nothing about the task's completion criterion.

SESSION_RUN_TERMINAL.definition: deriveSessionRunState is one of SUCCEEDED, FAILED, ENDED.

SESSION_LIFECYCLE_TERMINAL.definition: deriveSessionLifecycleState is one of COMPLETED, TRASH.

SESSION_NEEDS_ATTENTION.definition: At least one Approval row for the session has status PENDING.

TASK_TERMINAL.definition: task.status is one of DONE, CANCELLED, FAILED.

TASK_DONE.definition: task.status is DONE, which is the projection of a satisfied completion criterion and never a direct write.

notes: Closed set. No shell, no SQL, no log regex, no free-text expression.
A predicate is evaluated only against the columns its leaves declare in sourceColumns.

transitions.trigger: predicate true and mode is ONE_SHOT; the Match is recorded in the same transaction
now >= expiresAt; pausing does not extend TTL
permission recheck failed at evaluation or delivery time
every target is GONE, so the predicate can never be decided

watch.continuousNote: A CONTINUOUS watch stays ACTIVE after a match and increments generation.

CONTINUOUS watch only: the leaf went false again
a worker claimed it under (leaseOwner, leaseGeneration)
the action was performed exactly once
retryable failure or lease expiry; attempt count increments

match.note: A Match is a fact about the world. It is not a notification; the effect is a WatchDelivery.

actions.effect: One user-visible notification, counted by the existing needs-you badge path.
Enqueue exactly one ConversationTurn on the observer session through the normal queue entry point, carrying a structured payload.

idempotency.why: conversation_turn has UNIQUE (session_id, client_turn_id), so a redelivered match collapses onto the turn already enqueued instead of waking the session twice. This is the same mechanism TASK_RUN_TRIGGER already uses for sched:/dep:/first-run:/batch: turns.

sendIntent.why: A wake is new work, never a steer into the turn already running. CURRENT_WORK would be refused as CURRENT_WORK_UNAVAILABLE whenever no live in-flight message exists, which is precisely the common case for a parked observer.

actions.runningObserver: No special case: an observer that is RUNNING keeps its status and the turn queues behind the running one (statusAfterTurnEnqueued leaves RUNNING alone and moves AWAITING_INPUT/INTERRUPTED to PENDING). Watch never resumes a session concurrently because it never bypasses the queue.
actions.forbidden: Polling logs or shell transcript text must never be put into the payload.

refusals.when: The snapshot resolved to zero targets; ALL over an empty set would be vacuously true.
A leaf's targetKind does not match a target's kind.
Nesting exceeds limits.maxPredicateDepth or operands exceed maxOperandsPerComposite.
A kind outside aggregations/composites, or a leaf outside leaves.
The request's predicateVersion is not served by this build.
A TASK_LIST/PROJECT ref was given as live membership rather than a creation-time snapshot source.
A RESUME_SESSION watch names its own observer session among its targets.
The observer cannot read every target at create time.

factSource.authoritative: PostgreSQL rows named by each leaf's sourceColumns, read inside the evaluating transaction.

accelerantOnly.durability: never persisted; at-most-once; no ack, no retry
accelerantOnly.ordering: not guaranteed per connection (streamForUser uses mergeMap over an async mapper)
accelerantOnly.replay: none: no cursor and no Last-Event-ID on the control plane
accelerantOnly.onRestart: everything in flight is lost; the hub is process memory
namedDropPaths: pg_notify failure is caught and warn-logged only
payload over MAX_NOTIFY_BYTES degrades to a seq-signal, and synthetic control events carry seq 0 with no persisted row to re-read
owner or session summary resolves null mid-flight

accelerantOnly.coalescing: repeated signals collapse into one unconsumed row with an occurrences counter, so a consumer may not assume one row per occurrence

coverageGap.consequence: session.completed_at is NOT in that column list, so moving a Session to Completed writes no outbox row at all, and Approval writes are on a different table entirely. SESSION_LIFECYCLE_TERMINAL and SESSION_NEEDS_ATTENTION therefore have leaves no durable event covers: the sweep is load-bearing for them, not a backstop.

factSource.invariant: Dropping every hint changes only latency. Liveness is owned by nextEvaluateAt plus the leased reconciliation sweep.
factSource.forbidden: A Match must never be derived from the content of an event payload.

vectors.why: AWAITING_INPUT left PENDING/RUNNING, so the turn settled, but the session is alive and still Open.
The headline separation: an agent parking for input is not a completion criterion being satisfied.
A bare INTERRUPTED is a stopped turn on a live, schedulable session.
Any recorded endReason means the session itself ended, settling ENDED.
Succeeded-and-Open is a normal state; run outcome and list membership are orthogonal.
DONE is the projection of a satisfied criterion, not of a session finishing.
Terminal is the union DONE/CANCELLED/FAILED; failure is the narrower question.
The canonical agent request: wake me when all seven settle or any one fails. The ANY branch fires first.
ALL over nothing is vacuously true and would fire instantly; it is refused at create instead.
A task leaf cannot be evaluated against a session row.
Creation evaluates once; a satisfied condition produces a Match rather than waiting for a future change.
One-shot settles at MATCHED; the unique index makes a duplicate impossible rather than unlikely.
Hints only schedule evaluation; the row state decides, so replays and reordering are absorbed.
A session blocked on an approval is asking a human something while its turn is still unsettled; needs-attention and settled are independent axes.
The 0133 session trigger fires only on status/deleted_at/merge_status, so moving a session to Completed writes no durable event; a watch that trusted the event stream would wait forever.
Correctness may not depend on the event stream; the sweep is what makes a lost NOTIFY a latency bug only.
A GONE target leaves the set and is recorded; it is never silently counted as satisfied.
A watch that can never be decided must say so; stopping quietly is the failure mode being designed out.
Permission is rechecked at delivery, so revocation between create and match cannot leak target state.
A session waiting on a watch that expires must be told, or it waits forever.
Delivery goes through the normal queue, so a running session is never concurrently resumed.
A session that wakes itself is an unbounded wake loop.
A Match is an immutable fact about the epoch it observed; later reopening does not rewrite history.
Debounce and coalescing are what keep a continuous watch from becoming a wake storm.
v1 freezes the target set at create; live membership needs sealed semantics that do not exist yet.
